text: The 5060's performance isn't bad, but its memory is intentionally limited to only 8GB. In 2025, I bought a 3060 because I don't have high gaming requirements; I wanted to play simple AI games, but my budget was limited (a brand new card plus about $200), so an NVIDIA card with 12GB of RAM was the bare minimum. Fortunately, the 3060, after being undervolted, lost a little performance but became more power-efficient and cooler. If I only play 1080p games and don't play AI games, the 5060 would probably be my first choice. (Of course, if my budget allowed, I would seriously consider the 4060 Ti 16GB or 5060 Ti 16GB; these two are the entry-level all-around graphics cards.)
